messages:
anya: Heads-up — we're bootstrapping a new org 'harpoon' for a short research pilot (eu-central1 + us-west1). Need a cross-cloud preflight for GPUs, networking, and billing tags before we hand off to solutions. Draft checklist below, can infra folks confirm numbers and who will file the quota requests?

anya: Checklist (proposal):
• AWS (eu-central-1): 8x p4d or 16x p3 equivalents in reserved warm pool, increase EIP soft limit to 50, ENI limit + vCPU quota to match.
• GCP (europe-west3 + us-west1): 8x a2 (A100) capacity request per region, increase static IP quota to 40, regional network egress increase to 8 TB/month for the org project.
• Azure (West Europe): 4x ND A100 v4s initially, request accelerated networking vCPU quota bump and public IP limit to 20.
• IAM: org-level infra service account + project-level deployer role. Need tag enforcement: cost-center=research, team=platform.
• Billing: pre-attach billing account and add forecast alarms (30% and 80%).

sam: Confirming. Numbers look sane. I can file AWS + Azure requests. Can someone own GCP?

mike: I'll take GCP. Couple of notes:
- For GCP request use the region 'europe-west3' (Frankfurt) for eu-central-like latency; us-west1 for parity.
- Ask for quota increase for GPUs AND regional CPUs (some quotas gate VM creation).
- Include a separate request for internal load-balancer forwarding rule quota if we want internal proxy shards.

jess: Tag enforcement: finance wants the exact cost-center tag value to map to billing center 'res-pilot-2026'. Send me the org ID and the project IDs you plan to create so I can pre-wire the cost allocation.

anya: Org ID is org-0139-harpoon. Initial projects: harpoon-core, harpoon-run, harpoon-monitor.

sam: filing notes for AWS: will request Service Quota increases. Example commands I use (for records):

```bash
# AWS request template (service-quotas)
aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 50 # EIP
aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-0263D0A3 --desired-value 1000 # vCPU (runs at account/region)
# For GPUs sometimes we need case via support:
aws support create-case --subject "GPU quota increase" --serviceCode AmazonEC2 --severity-code low --categoryCode quotaIncrease --communicationBody "Need 8 p4d capacity in eu-central-1 for org harpoon"
```

mike: GCP request snippets:
```bash
# Check regional quotas
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west3 --project=harpoon-core
# Submit quota request via console (AI Platform / Compute Engine) with note: reserve 8 A100s and bump CPUs by 200
```

sam: Azure snippet for request: 
```bash
az vm list-usage --location westeurope -o table --query "[?localName=='Total Regional vCPUs']"
# then open a support request and request Public IPs and vCPU increases referencing subscription sub-0-harpoon
```

ops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-8452 — "harpoon org quota preflight". Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-8452

mike: One operational caveat — if cloud providers can't approve warm pool in time, we should stage with smaller live capacity and use our warm-pool autoscale policy. Add fallback plan to the ticket.

anya: Good call. Fallback plan: start with 2x A100 / p4d live, warm-pool scaling to requested numbers, and enable prefix KV cache on model infra to reduce warmup.

jess: Also confirm who will own the cost alerts. I can set up the billing alerts once projects exist but need an owner with permissions.

anya: I'll own alerts during pilot; will hand to platform after 2 weeks.

sam: Filing AWS+Azure by EOD. mike will file GCP tomorrow morning. I'll add all tag requirements and include the billing project mapping in the ticket notes.

anya: Awesome — thanks. I'll update the rollout checklist in the ticket and add a short playbook on how to scale back if we hit egress charges. :thumbsup:

anya: Quick follow-up: can someone drop the exact support-case copy for AWS so I can paste to solution engineering?

sam: Pasting short form: 
"Request: increase Elastic IP limit to 50 and vCPU quota to 1000 in eu-central-1 for org org-0139-harpoon. Purpose: reserved warm pool for research pilot; expected peak sustained GPU instances: 8 p4d (or equivalent). Contact: sam@redwood.com. Please link to INFRA-8452."

anya: Perfect, filing now.

anya: Filing done — ticket updated with support case numbers and links. I'll ping when we get confirmations.

ops-bot: INFRA-8452 updated: AWS case# 20304567, GCP request# 887-2026-01 (pending), Azure SR# 9901123.

mike: Noted. Once GCP is approved, I'll verify region quotas + forward-rule limits.

jess: I added the billing allocation for projects. Finance alarm thresholds set to 30/80.

anya: Thanks everyone. Closing sync here — will escalate if any provider stalls.
